title: Skinny: Set some masks to match boolean field width

notes.body: Oops.  There is a check in tools/check_typed_item_calls.py (isGeneratedFile()) which matches "Generated automatically" but not "Generated Automatically".

Annoyingly, there is a comment in the generated file that says to generate the file you should call ./sag.py, however it is tools/xml2skinny_dissector.py.  If I find time later on, I will change tools/xml2skinny_dissector.py to output the correct build instructions for itself, and change the comment to "Generated automatically" (there are other scripts that run the same check for whether dissectors are generated or not).
Actually, I will edit epan/dissectors/packet-skinny.c.in - I'm still not sure what the role of cag.py is and where it comes from.

Reverted in https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6587

As I noted there, I wasn't able to regenerate - got some python exception..
